W.note: Slow fog-like bezier gradient bloom with rising motes feels ethereal, though the pale white rest state is low-affordance and the long 1-2.4s timings plus blur layers are heavier.

X.note: Clean dark button with a soft glow and light pass, fast 180ms leave and good focus and reduced motion, but the hover is too subtle to read as dreamlike.

Y.note: Well-engineered, realistic hero page with solid states and documented curves, but the hover change is barely visible and not ethereal.

Z.note: Pastel iridescent gradient drift with a spinning sparkle and soft overshoot is the most dreamlike and polished, with legible dark label, focus ring and reduced-motion handling.
